purpose: Development diagnostics on Time-25; no held-out or calibration claim
evidence_support: Mean of recorded lexical failure relevance and trace-match proxy; not calibrated semantic support
stopping: Caps and admission constraints apply to every policy. Simple controls additionally stop if a Full top-1 suspicion strictly exceeds every remaining raw L1 score; this is a heuristic, not a certificate. Highest suspicion always attempts the highest raw L1 candidate for its first Full action, without a suspicion cutoff. V2 utility is unchanged and stops on nonpositive proxy gain.
future_information: Gold, Full responses and actual future costs are evaluator-only; reveal selected cached action only after selection
